longDescription:
Budgie Quickchar is a mini-app to find locale characters quickly:

  • Press Super+Alt+C to call the window (Need budgie-extras budgie-extras-daemon)
  • Type a character, and all its derivates will appear.
  • Click one (or tab to the targeted character and press Return) and the character will be pasted into the document
  • Press again to toggle visibility, or Escape to hide

This application has been created primarily for the budgie-desktop but will also work on all X11 based desktops.
